title: Patient cuts in mid-explanation to correct their date of birth

persona.name: Gerald Okafor
persona.style: older, polite but brisk, a deep unhurried voice
persona.extra: The first time they ask your date of birth, you slip and say August twelfth, nineteen seventy-five. Don't correct it on your own; you'll catch it later.

goals.goal: Book a follow-up visit for knee pain sometime next week.
Make sure the booking ends up under your real date of birth, August twelfth, nineteen fifty-seven.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: This call may be recorded for quality and training purposes.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Good morning,

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Thanks for calling Pivot Point Orthopaedics.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Part of [company]. How may I help you today?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: I'm calling to book a follow-up visit for my knee pain sometime next week.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I see you're calling from the number we have on file. Am I speaking with Maria?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, this is Gerald Okafor. I'd like to book that appointment for myself.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Please provide your date of birth. Gerald.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: It's August twelfth, nineteen seventy-five.

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Oh, sorry, sorry, I gave you the wrong year. It's nineteen fifty-seven, not seventy-five.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Just to confirm, is your date of birth August twelfth nineteen fifty seven?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, that's correct, August twelfth, nineteen fifty-seven. And about that appointment for next week, is there a slot available on Tuesday in the morning?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Before I can check the schedule, could you please spell your first and last name for me?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's G-E-R-A-L-D for Gerald, and O-K-A-F-O-R for Okafor. And yes, next Tuesday in the morning works if you have something.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: To look up your record, Could you tell me the phone number you have on file with us?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: The number you have is 555-0108. Now, about that Tuesday appointment. Do you have any openings at ten o'clock?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I need the four number you have on file to look up your record.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Could you provide all ten digits, please?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Sure, it's 555-0108. Sorry, I didn't give you the full number before. Can you check for a ten o'clock appointment next Tuesday now?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I need the full ten digit phone number.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Including the area code that you have on file with us.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: You say the complete number for me?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Yes, the full number is 555-0108, but I don't have an area code to give you. If you need it, maybe you can check with what you have on file. Is there a slot at ten next Tuesday?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I need either your full name, date of birth, and a complete ten digit phone number, or just your name and date of birth. To look up your record. Could you please spell your first and last name for me one more time along with your date of birth?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: Alright, it's G-E-R-A-L-D O-K-A-F-O-R, and my date of birth is August twelfth, nineteen fifty-seven. Hopefully, that helps you find my record. Now, about that appointment next Tuesday at ten?

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: I can't proceed further right now. But I can make sure our clinic support team follows up with you.

lines.speaker: AGENT
lines.text: Would you like me to connect you to our patient support team?

lines.speaker: PATIENT
lines.text: No, thank you. I appreciate your help. I'll try calling back later to book that appointment. Goodbye.
